decision.reason: 12 October Electronic Times primary account says Korea Small Enterprise and Market Service policy meeting explored introducing physical AI to traditional small-manufacturing workshops, particularly preserving skilled craft knowledge, documenting rights in resulting know-how, and defining sharing terms between craftspeople and robot developers. A proposed collaboration model, NOT enacted national grant or legal licensing obligation. Manual skill-step capture and rights approval evidence is a concrete craft/business job without needing to run AI.
